verse.text: But those who won't care for their relatives, especially those in their own household, have denied the true faith. Such people are worse than unbelievers.

video.title: "Worse Than an Unbeliever?" | 1 Timothy 5:8 & Family Responsibility

reflection: Providing for your family isn't just about the paycheck — it's showing up, following through, and being the guy your household can count on when it's inconvenient. God ties this so closely to faith that Paul says neglecting it undercuts everything else you claim to believe. Today, ask yourself: is there one area — time, attention, finances — where you've been coasting instead of covering your family?
